description: Evidence-bounded incident, outage, security, continuity, recovery, communication, and closure review without external effects.

routing.when_to_use: Use for evidence-backed company outage, security, continuity, recovery, communication, and closure review.
when_not_to_use: Do not use as an incident tracker, deployment controller, backup system, or customer messaging transport.
Do not deploy, roll back, isolate, rotate credentials, close, or approve.
Do not use with live credentials, customer records, raw logs, or confidential incident text.
exclusion_rules: Responders, Platform, Program Ledger, and deployment authorities retain their respective mutation authority.
Consumer adapters retain transport, credential, and communication authority.

required_inputs.name: incident_request
required_inputs.description: Incident type, severity, state, owner references, evidence, impact, recovery, communication, and optional closure data.

expected_outputs.name: incident_review
expected_outputs.description: A deterministic READY_FOR_OWNER, DRAFT, or BLOCKED review with closure evidence and empty effects.

execution.procedure_summary: Validate identity and evidence, preserve impact and ownership, compare recovery options, draft communications, and require evidence-backed closure without mutation.
forbidden_actions: Deploy, rollback, isolate, rotate credentials, or mutate infrastructure
Approve or close incidents, recovery, continuity, Program Ledger, or deployment state
Store credentials, customer data, raw incident records, or confidential company material
verification_steps: Run focused incident and continuity tests
Run secret scan and generated-output closure
Confirm prohibited deploy/config/catalog paths are unchanged
completion_criteria: Outage, security, continuity, recovery, communication, and closure cases are evaluated
Owning responder, Platform, Program Ledger, and deployment authority remain explicit
Closure requires evidence and residual risks
Effects remain empty and private input is rejected without echo

telemetry.retention_policy: retain synthetic IDs, evidence hashes, and receipts only
